craft pace.p90: 90th percentile shot 8.5 s, target ≤ 6 s; a long hold has to be a designed one; cut to the listener's face or an insert (hook-001, hook-002, hook-003, hook-004, hook-005, hook-006, origin-008, origin-009, … 73) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft pace.longest: longest shot 9.2 s, target ≤ 8 s; longer than the shortest clip the pipeline buys (hook-003, hook-005, hook-006, origin-009, origin-010, engine-037, engine-038, turn-058, … 14) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft pace.spread: long shots against short ones (90th ÷ 10th percentile) 1.3, target ≥ 2; every shot the same length is a metronome: a three-to-five-character line for a quick shot, two lines held on one shot before a reveal (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft hook.opening: shots that start in the first 10 s 2, target ≥ 4; open inside the event: place, the lead doing something, the lead's face, the other side's reaction (hook-001, hook-002) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
craft hook.opening30: shots that start in the first 30 s 4, target ≥ 10; the opening half-minute is where the density goes (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft hook.dialogue: first line spoken by a character never, target ≤ 10 s; let someone in the scene speak first; a retelling with no speaking characters answers this row in the report (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.median: median line length 24 characters, target ≤ 12; people in a scene speak in short turns; break the sentence where the cut goes (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.long: lines over 20 characters 73%, target ≤ 10%; a line this long holds one picture too long; split it across two shots (hook-001, hook-003, hook-004, hook-005, hook-006, origin-008, origin-010, origin-011, … 63) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.narrator: narration and inner voice, share of the spoken text 100%, target ≤ 35%; turn narration into what a character says or does; keep it for time jumps (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.face: faces (medium close-up and closer, over-the-shoulder) 39%, target ≥ 40%; the audience follows a face; give each turn of the scene a face that reacts (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.insert: inserts 0%, target 5%–25%; an insert answers a story question (which paper, whose hand); too few hides the proof, too many hides the people (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.look: shots where the only behaviour is a look, a breath or a tremor 100%, target ≤ 33%; reaction shots are needed, a third is the ceiling: elsewhere write what the person does to someone or something (hook-001, hook-002, hook-003, hook-004, hook-005, hook-006, hook-007, origin-008, … 75) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.run: such shots in a row 75 shots, target ≤ 2; three looks in a row is three portraits: put an action between them (hook-001, hook-002, hook-003, hook-004, hook-005, hook-006, hook-007, origin-008, … 75) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.opening: first three shots all looks, target something happens; the opening is an action in progress, not three portraits (hook-001, hook-002, hook-003) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft risk.decorative: shots with nobody in them that are not inserts 75% (56), target ≤ 10%; a place with nobody in it is a postcard: put the person about to act in the frame, or make it an insert that answers a question (hook-001, hook-002, hook-003, hook-004, hook-006, hook-007, origin-008, origin-009, … 56) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
